name: Gacha
desc: CS:GO-grade case opening. Official odds, strip spin reveal, and pull statistics.
descZh: CSGO 分级开箱:官方概率、转轮揭晓动画与抽取统计。

touch.action: Tap the case to draw; tap Draw Again on the result to draw again
touch.actionZh: 点击箱子抽取；结果页点击「再抽一次」继续抽取

keyboard.actionZh: 在收藏册中切换稀有度

touch.action: Open Collection, then tap a rarity tier to browse its items
touch.actionZh: 打开「收藏册」，点击稀有度查看对应物品

notes.text: Each draw is recorded once when opening begins. Browsing Collection or returning to Gacha during the reveal keeps that draw.
notes.textZh: 每次抽取在开箱开始时记录一次。揭晓期间浏览收藏册或返回抽卡，不会丢失本次抽取。

touch.action: Open the game menu for Stats or Sound; checked Sound means enabled
touch.actionZh: 打开游戏菜单，选择「抽取统计」或「音效」；音效勾选表示已开启

notes.text: Stats is unavailable while a case is unlocking or spinning; Sound can still be changed in the menu.
notes.textZh: 解锁或转轮揭晓期间无法打开统计；仍可在菜单中切换音效。

notes.text: In an isolated host without game-menu actions, S and M still provide Stats and Sound.
notes.textZh: 在没有游戏菜单操作的独立环境中，仍可用 S 查看统计、M 切换音效。

keyboard.action: Reset stats and collection outside an opening
keyboard.actionZh: 非开箱期间重置统计与收藏进度

touch.action: Use Back to Gacha in Collection, Stats, or during an opening
touch.actionZh: 在收藏册、统计页或开箱期间点击「返回抽卡」

touch.action: Use the selector beneath the case when multiple opening animations are available
touch.actionZh: 有多种开箱动画时，可点击箱子下方的选择器切换

notes.text: Shift+R clears saved pulls and collection progress. Returning with Escape or R never resets them.
notes.textZh: Shift+R 会清除已保存的抽取记录与收藏进度；Escape 或 R 返回不会重置进度。
